## filesystem
actions: filesystem.read, filesystem.write
write_roots: /workspace
read_roots: ., /workspace
allowed_effects: read, overwrite
blocked_paths: .env*
protected_file_classes: credentials
protected_class_catalog: catalog-v1
protected_effects: overwrite, delete
max_files_per_action: 10
require_shim: true

## git
actions: git.status, git.push
filesystem_actions: filesystem.write
providers: github
allowed_remote_schemes: https, ssh
allowed_operations: status, push_fast_forward, force_push
require_approval: force_push
blocked_operations: force_push
protected_refs: refs/heads/main, refs/tags/*
max_ref_changes_per_task: 2
require_shim: true

## database
actions: database.query, database.write
protected_environments: production
allowed_operations: select, update
require_approval: update
allowed_resources: public.*, audit.log
routine_catalog: catalog-v1
require_read_only_for_select: true
deny_unreviewed_indirect_effects: true
max_schema_changes_per_task: 1
statement_timeout_ms: 5000
lock_timeout_ms: 1000
require_shim: true
